name: Solumen
tagline: Lab-grade soil science for the ground you actually tend.
positioning: Solumen turns a mail-in soil sample into a clear, seasonal reading of your plot — so home growers can amend with intention, not guesswork.

hero.h1: Know exactly what your soil is asking for.
hero.sub: Mail us a small sample and Solumen returns a lab-grade reading of pH, nutrients, and organic matter — paired with an amendment plan written for your beds, not a spreadsheet.

features.title: Lab-grade soil reports
features.description: Every sample runs through certified labs for pH, N-P-K, micronutrients, and organic matter — returned as a plain-language report you can actually act on.

features.title: Amendment plans that fit your plot
features.description: Get precise quantities of compost, lime, or gypsum for each bed — measured to your square footage, so you stop over-applying and guessing.

features.title: Season-over-season tracking
features.description: Watch your soil improve. Solumen charts every test against your last one, showing how last spring's amendments moved the numbers.

features.title: Plant-specific guidance
features.description: Tell us you're growing tomatoes, blueberries, or a native meadow, and recommendations shift to the pH and nutrient window each crop prefers.

features.title: Prepaid mail-in kits
features.description: A soil probe, sample bags, and a postage-paid return mailer arrive at your door. Scoop, seal, and drop it in the mail — results in five days.

features.title: Regional benchmarks
features.description: See how your soil compares to gardens in your county, so you know whether that low potassium is your plot or your whole region.

testimonials.quote: I'd been dumping lime on my beds for years on a hunch. Solumen showed my pH was already fine and my real problem was phosphorus. One report saved me a whole season of guessing.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Halloran

testimonials.quote: We test four blocks of the vineyard every spring. The season-over-season charts are the only reason I finally understand what our cover crops are doing to organic matter.
testimonials.name: Dario Fenwick

testimonials.quote: As an urban grower on reclaimed lots, I need to trust the numbers. The lab reports and plain-English amendment plans made our raised beds usable in one season.
testimonials.name: Priya Ostrander

homepage.footerBlurb: Solumen brings certified lab analysis to the people who actually get their hands dirty. Better soil, one honest reading at a time.
